image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vintage, heavily rusted cast-iron sad iron (box iron) resting on a purple textured fabric surface. The iron features a hollow body with a hinged top and a large, arched metal handle that is also significantly corroded. The soleplate has a distinctive scalloped or wavy edge design rather than a smooth modern triangular shape. There are no visible steam holes, dials, or power cords, indicating it is an antique non-electric model.
